answer.rationale: Write-path p99 at 5x began after a release that is still inside the last two hours, so the last-known-stable build is the only candidate that can restore availability if the deploy is causal. memory_b1 is the matching restore playbook, but it describes an error spike rather than write latency, so I am verifying that record before treating rollback as confirmed. I am not enabling a circuit breaker: memory_b4 contained a partner fault by failing fast, which would drop customer writes and violates the objective. memory_b3 (pre-peak headroom) and the coincident settlement surge remain live alternative explanations, so capacity is not ruled out; therefore keep the rollback small and guarded rather than fleet-wide, and do not claim a single root cause.
